Attached: 1 image

Want to ask questions of your own notes without pasting them into someone's chatbot?

One conn3x apply builds a DigitalOcean droplet, closes everything but SSH, and runs Ollama and Qdrant on 127.0.0.1. Your laptop reaches them through an SSH tunnel.

We tested it: 101 resources in 2m36s, a 0.806 search hit, back after a reboot, gone in 41 seconds. $24 a month, or about 4 cents an hour to try.

https://conn3x.org/blog/private-ai-box

#SelfHosted #Ollama #HomeLab #OpenTofu
